profile.name: PAWAN K. KUSHWAHA
profile.bio: I'm an Industrial & Product Designer who loves turning ideas into meaningful products and experiences. I design at the intersection of function, simplicity and human needs.

about.bioParagraph1: I’m Pawan K. Kushwaha, a designer curious about how things work, how people interact with them, and how thoughtful design can make everyday experiences better.
about.bioParagraph2: From sketching and 3D modeling to prototyping and testing, I enjoy turning early ideas into practical solutions. I believe good design begins with understanding people and grows through curiosity, experimentation, and iteration.
about.toolsNote: Tools I use to turn ideas into products.
about.beyondDesc: Exploring new tools, making physical products, and learning through hands-on experiments.

projects.title: KINETIC CHAIR
projects.shortDesc: Ergonomic study chairs exploring lightweight bent plywood geometry and spine curvature...
projects.description:
Kinetic Chair is an ergonomic furniture concept exploring how a lightweight bent-plywood structure can support the body through controlled curvature and minimal material use.

The project focuses on developing a chair that balances ergonomics, structural efficiency, comfort, and visual simplicity. The design process explores body posture, seating geometry, material behavior, and the relationship between form and manufacturing.
projects.desc2: The project focuses on developing a chair that balances ergonomics, structural efficiency, comfort, and visual simplicity. The design process explores body posture, seating geometry, material behavior, and the relationship between form and manufacturing.
projects.projectBrief: An ergonomic chair concept exploring lightweight bent-plywood geometry and spine-supporting curvature.
projects.tools: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, CNC Router, Vacuum Press Lamination
projects.deliverable: 1:5 Scale Study Models, 1:1 Full Scale Prototype, Structural FEA

projects.title: LUMA — Minimalist Modular Desk Lamp
projects.shortDesc: A minimalist modular desk lamp exploring diffused warm lighting and ergonomic pivot points.
projects.description: LUMA is an exploration in reductive industrial design and thermal management. A minimalist modular desk lamp exploring diffused warm lighting and ergonomic pivot points. Machined from billet 6061 aluminum with an integrated capacitive touch slider in the base, LUMA offers continuous dimming and circadian color-temperature tuning.
projects.desc1: LUMA is an exploration in reductive industrial design and thermal management, creating a minimalist modular desk luminaire with intuitive touch controls.
projects.desc2: Machined from billet 6061 aluminum with an integrated capacitive slider in the base, LUMA offers continuous circadian color-temperature tuning and glare-free illumination.
projects.projectBrief: A minimalist modular desk lamp exploring diffused warm lighting, CNC aluminum housing, and ergonomic pivot points.
projects.tools: Autodesk Fusion 360, Keyshot, SLA 3D Printing, CNC Milling
projects.deliverable: DFM CAD Packages, Working Functional Prototype, Bill of Materials

projects.title: ANALOG — Tactile Digital Camera
projects.shortDesc: A tactile digital camera concept prioritizing mechanical feedback with physical click wheels and vintage ergonomics.
projects.description: A tactile digital camera concept prioritizing mechanical feedback with physical click wheels and vintage ergonomics. In an era of frictionless touchscreens, ANALOG restores the tactile joy of photography through knurled aluminum control dials, mechanical shutter release clickers, and an organic status display inspired by 1970s rangefinders.
